output.question: How many employees does Capital One have?
output.answer: Capital One reported 77.5 thousand employees at period-end September 30, 2026—approximately 77,500 employees. This is the most recent employee count I found as of November 11, 2026, reported in Capital One's third-quarter 2026 results released October 20, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Capital One reported 77.5 thousand employees at period-end, equivalent to approximately 77,500 employees.
Capital One released its third-quarter 2026 results on October 20, 2026.

passages.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation / Business Wire

caveats: The reported figure is rounded to the nearest hundred employees because it is presented in thousands.
This is a period-end figure for September 30, 2026, not a live headcount on November 11, 2026.
